channel.title: AI GridWatch — Vermont data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Vermont, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Vermont (S.205): data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: S.205 (Sen. Rebecca White) would bar constructing or operating an AI data center drawing over 100 MW of new electricity until Jul 1, 2030, with a PUC impact study due Jan 15, 2027. Introduced Jan 6, referred to Senate Finance, no vote taken
